title: Lifecycle events carry only the metadata-only whitelist
asA: operator running the applied logging companion against the KV facade
iWant: every lifecycle event on the injected sink to carry only {event, key, size, ttl, timestamp} and nothing else
soThat: the log stream can render KV activity without ever writing a body byte or a metadata blob

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each lifecycle event emitted by the facade carries EXACTLY the whitelist {event, key, size, ttl, timestamp}. No body value, no metadata blob, no additional field ever appears on the record the sink receives. A whitelist scan on the recorded events returns zero forbidden keys.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the facade wired to a spy event sink, with a mix of put/get/delete/list operations
acceptanceCriteria.then: the sink records each event with only the whitelist keys; any extra key trips the probe

acceptanceCriteria.description: Additional field mutation: a wrapper sink that adds a top-level "requestId" key onto every record trips the whitelist scan; the probe surfaces "requestId" as a forbidden key and returns aggregateVerdict:"fail". Under the shipped path (no wrapper) the scan returns zero forbidden hits.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade wired to a wrapper sink that appends "requestId" onto every record
acceptanceCriteria.when: a mix of put/get/delete/list operations run
acceptanceCriteria.then: the whitelist scan surfaces "requestId" as a forbidden key; aggregateVerdict is "fail"

acceptanceCriteria.description: Causal event ordering: a facade.put(k, v) followed synchronously by a facade.get(k) emits records on the sink in the order kvWrite(k,size:<n>), kvHit(k,size:<n>). Interleaved sequences preserve issue order per TAC-3203 responsibility (serialise events in emit order).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade with a spy sink
acceptanceCriteria.when: facade.put(k, v) then facade.get(k) run synchronously
acceptanceCriteria.then: the sink records kvWrite(k) at index i and kvHit(k) at index i+1 (adjacent, in that order)

acceptanceCriteria.description: Vocabulary is closed to the four kinds: the shipped facade emits event kinds exactly from the set {facadeReady, kvHit, kvMiss, kvWrite}. A probe that runs put/get/delete/list against a fresh facade and inspects the emitted record.event values asserts every value is in the set; no unexpected kind (e.g. "kvList" or "kvBatch") is emitted.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fresh facade with a spy sink
acceptanceCriteria.when: facadeReady, put, get on a hit, get on a miss, delete and list run
acceptanceCriteria.then: every record.event value is in {facadeReady, kvHit, kvMiss, kvWrite}
